testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-portal.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-31734 sales rep accounts list shows its parent and child accounts

scenario.summary: The rep is the effective sales rep of parent A, of child A (inherited from parent A) and of child B (own rep, overriding parent B's rep); signed in, its Accounts page lists parent A, child A and child B, not parent B.
steps: Sign in to the admin panel as the sales rep (@rep.userName, @rep.password).
assertions: @parentB.accountName is not listed (No records found. when searched)
evidence: Story Z10-38546 (SalesRep - Phase 2, account association), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-38546/analysis.md sections 3-4 and answers in section 6.
FSD section 12 (Accounts page: all accounts, parent and child, where the rep is the effective Sales Rep), section 5 Scenarios 1 and 2 (inheritance; child assignment overrides).
The sales rep signs in on the suite's admin URL with the password the SALES_REP_OF_STORE collection sets through the API (Phase 1 analysis answer 2).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A), as in the Phase 1 tests.
ACCOUNT_OF_STORE, CHILD_ACCOUNT_OF_ACCOUNT and USER_OF_ACCOUNT are new consumable keys (analysis section 4, pending approval; collections still to build through the account and customer APIs).

Child A inherited: CHILD_ACCOUNT_OF_ACCOUNT under parent A (Enable Sales Rep Inheritance Yes) with rep = @parentA.salesRepUserId; this mirrors what the admin UI sends when inheritance is Yes (atstage's account API does not apply inheritance itself on this build).
Child B overridden: under parent B (other rep @repOther) with its own rep = @rep.userId. Parent B not listed is an extra negative check backed by FSD section 12.
